description: Looks up a fish species by its name in any language of the site or its Latin name and returns what the Slovak decree says about it: year-round protection, minimum size, closed season, water types, plus the page URL. Informative only; always check the rules of the specific water.

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

name.description: Species name in Slovak, Latin or another supported language, e.g. "šťuka", "Esox lucius", "pike", "Hecht", "csuka", "щука", "pstruh potočný".

name: get_fish_species
title: Fish species and regulation
